title: sign.rs: wrap_base64 and encrypt.rs: build_mime fold loop are duplicated with expect
description: Both sign.rs (wrap_base64) and encrypt.rs (build_mime) implement the same base64-fold-at-76-chars logic with from_utf8().expect(). The pattern appears twice with the same comment 'b64 is a String/str — from_utf8 always succeeds'. This is minor duplication but if one is ever changed the other may lag. wrap_base64 could be moved to a shared utility module and reused by build_mime.
